conference: NHCAA Annual Training Conference (National Health Care Anti-Fraud Association)
source_note:
PARTIAL LIST - read this note before intake. NHCAA never published a full public exhibitor list for the 2025 edition (November 18-21, 2025, Gaylord Opryland, Nashville). The complete Anti-Fraud Expo directory existed ONLY inside the conference's Map Your Show event app and web program at https://atc2025.mapyourshow.com, named as the online directory in NHCAA's own app FAQ (https://www.nhcaa.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/ATC_App_FAQ2025.pdf: 'please visit the web browser link - https://atc2025.mapyourshow.com'). That site has been taken down: every path under atc2025.mapyourshow.com now answers 302 to https://www.nhcaa.org/events/annual-training-conference/, and the Wayback Machine holds ZERO captures of the host (CDX query for atc2025.mapyourshow.com returns nothing; archive.org/wayback/available returns no snapshots; archive.today has none either). Booth numbers below run from 512 to 816, so the real hall was on the order of 50-70 exhibitors; the 16 recorded here are the ones with a nameable public source. The 2023 edition DID get a full list (https://www.nhcaa.org/download/29227/ , 'ATC23 Exhibitors Sponsors', 55 companies with booths) - no 2025 equivalent exists anywhere in NHCAA's WordPress media library or Download Monitor library (checked every upload and every download post dated Sep 2025 - Feb 2026).

THREE SOURCES, all named per company in the 'tier' field:
(1) source_url above - NHCAA's own 'Thank you to our Visibility Sponsors' page for this edition, the only edition-specific sponsor page on nhcaa.org. Three companies, each a logo tile with a booth number and a typed blurb. CAVEAT: the tiles are LOGOS with empty alt text, so no company name is typed on the page except inside the blurbs; names here are read off the logo image filenames (cotiviti_web.png, HCFSLogo_FullColor-1.png, HMS_Logo_RGB.png) cross-checked against the 'Visit Us' download targets (/download/36988/ Cotiviti-sponsor2025, /download/36968/ HCFS-Sponsor2025, /download/36965/ HMS-Sponsor2025). The booth-804 tile carries an HMS logo but a Gainwell Technologies blurb - HMS is a Gainwell company and NHCAA's agenda types it 'HMS, a Gainwell Company'.
(2) The official ATC 2025 agenda PDF, 'AGENDA AS OF NOVEMBER 14, 2025 @ 8:39 AM', at https://www.nhcaa.org/download/36636/ . It names three event-function sponsors ('Sponsored by Cotiviti, Healthcare Fraud Shield and HMS' - Welcome Reception; 'Sponsored by SecureCare' - Coffee Break; 'Sponsored by Morgan & Morgan' - Expo Hall Reception) and twelve vendors who each bought a session slot, printed as 'Presented by X, an NHCAA Platinum Supporting Member'. A paid session at ATC is a supporter placement for this edition, which is why they are recorded here; it is NOT proof of a booth unless a booth number is also given.
(3) Each company's OWN page about this conference, fetched and read in full - these are the only places booth numbers for the non-visibility exhibitors are published. Each URL is in the company's 'tier' string.

DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED, so nobody re-adds them from a search snippet: CGI - search results quote 'Booth 217' from https://www.cgi.com/us/en-us/federal/nhcaa-atc, but that URL is a perennial page CGI reuses for every edition and it answers 403 (a real block page, title 'Access denied | CGI United States') to every fetch, so the booth could belong to 2026; unverified, left out. Commence - https://commence.ai/commence-at-nhcaa-2025/ now redirects to the commence.ai homepage, whose banner reads 'Meet Commence at NAMPI 2026. Live demos at Booth #9' - that is a different conference, and no NHCAA 2025 content survives on the page. Also excluded: the NHCAA Supporting Members and NHCAA Partner Directory rosters, which are membership lists, not lists of who was in the Nashville hall.

Fetched 2026-08-25.
